alt: 孩子替木椅裝上小紙翅膀，幻想它能載自己飛上天空，朋友看著簡陋材料露出疑惑。
scene_prompt: At a backyard craft table a child earnestly proposes an impossible homemade flying vehicle: a small ordinary wooden chair with two tiny paper wings attached, while holding a model umbrella above it as if this could lift a person. A soft translucent imagined scene shows that very chair carrying the smiling child high through clouds despite its absurdly flimsy construction. A practical friend looks puzzled at the real undersized paper wings. Clear unrealistic strange invention, no actual flight in reality, no written diagrams.
